Name: First Light - mini beach farm
Author: Lykkio
Description:
[i][b]12/27 update: [/b][/i]While testing new mod load-outs I realized my map didn't work well with many recolors, but now it should! The Blue Grass version received a small improvement to the waterfall, and the vanilla versions have had quite a few changes in order to look nice with more recolors. The changes were tested with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085?tab=description]Starblue[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23095]Soft Slow Seasons[/url].


First Light farm is a very small map designed to fit the entire beach aesthetic tidily on the screen. It is based on the rocky beaches of central California, complete with a tiny tide pool. This map replaces the ocean farm, including ocean fish and beach forage . The upper left corner has just enough space for a coop and barn, with invisible NPC barriers and a healthy amount of blue grass to start with. There is also the option to have a working trough for refilling your water can (and for your sweet animals of course!).

I designed this map with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10635]Blue Grass Recolor[/url] in mind for personal use, but it looked a little off in vanilla so I created a second version for vanilla and potentially other recolors. The layout is the same for both maps, but in vanilla a few trees are changed and the fossils in the cliff-side are removed.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]NoClip Mode[/url] is highly recommended in case of bugs

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18387]Map Editor Extended[/url] is also great if you'd like to make some personal changes!
